title: Ashbury Rewards Tier Benefits: Points Sharing Allowance for Upper Tiers
content:
Upper-tier Ashbury Rewards members who stay often may give more points to other members. The transfer allowance is set by the tier and by the elite night credits posted in the twelve months before the handling date, less the night credits reversed in those months.

## Allowance

| Tier | Net elite night credits in the twelve months | Transfer allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 75 or more | 300000 points |
| Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 50 to 74 | 200000 points |
| Platinum Elite | 50 or more | 200000 points |
| Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 49 or fewer | No enhanced allowance |
| Platinum Elite | 49 or fewer | No enhanced allowance |
| Member, Silver Elite or Gold Elite | any | No enhanced allowance |

In words: a member at Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite with at least seventy-five such night credits has a transfer allowance of three hundred thousand points; a member at Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite with at least fifty such night credits, or at Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite with fifty to seventy-four such night credits, has a transfer allowance of two hundred thousand points.

## The twelve months

The twelve months before the handling date are the transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date; the net figure is the night credits posted in that window less the night credits reversed in it.

## Cases (hypothetical members)

| Tier | Net night credits | Transfer allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Ambassador Elite | 75 | 300000 points |
| Ambassador Elite | 74 | 200000 points |
| Platinum Elite | 80 | 200000 points |
| Platinum Elite | 49 | No enhanced allowance |
| Gold Elite | 90 | No enhanced allowance |
